declared difference (truth fix T4, property flags): the awk read one declaration per line and its flags after the
line's LAST "newProperty(" up to the first ",", on that line only: aHours, whose Flags.TRANSIENT is on the next line,
counted as non-transient, and bHours took cHours' TRANSIENT while cHours was never read. Every declaration is read
now, its flags from its own "newProperty(" to the first "," (across lines).
-- args --
@DIR@
-- want --
exit 0
-- stderr --
-- Y.java --
class Y {
  public static final Property aHours = newProperty(
      Flags.TRANSIENT, 0.0, null);
  Property bHours = newProperty(0, 0.0, null); Property cHours = newProperty(Flags.TRANSIENT, 1, null);
  public void changed(Property p, Context cx) {
    if (p == a) execute();
    if (p == b) execute();
    if (p == c) execute();
    if (p == d) execute();
    if (p == e) execute();
    if (p == f) execute();
    if (p == g) execute();
  }
  void execute() { setAHours(1); setCHours(1); }
}
